A '''holofile''' was a computer data file with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] user-interface.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] encouraged [[Padawan/Legends|students]] at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to remember to back up their holofiles.
{{Noncanonend}}
